visual_elements.description: Scatter plot (XY chart) with no gridlines, no numeric tick labels, and no legend. Axes are plain red arrows: vertical y-axis labeled 'Weight' (values increase upward, unlabeled scale) and horizontal x-axis labeled 'Length' (values increase rightward, unlabeled scale). Approximately 23 circular orange markers with darker orange/red outlines form a positive linear correlation rising from lower-left to upper-right. Approximate marker positions (as fraction of plot width/height from left/bottom): (0.22,0.18), (0.26,0.15), (0.30,0.22), (0.32,0.17), (0.35,0.16), (0.38,0.17), (0.42,0.24), (0.44,0.29), (0.45,0.25), (0.48,0.27), (0.49,0.31), (0.54,0.26), (0.55,0.34), (0.60,0.35), (0.61,0.36), (0.67,0.35), (0.73,0.42), (0.75,0.50), (0.83,0.49), (0.84,0.54), (0.89,0.54), (0.90,0.64), (0.95,0.67). Two points are highlighted with thin red dotted projection lines: the point at ~(0.75,0.50) has a horizontal dotted line to the y-axis and a vertical dotted line down to the x-axis; the point at ~(0.67,0.35) likewise has horizontal and vertical dotted lines to both axes. A small red arrowhead marker sits on the y-axis at the height of the upper highlighted point (~0.50). A white mouse cursor with black outline floats over the plot at ~(0.89,0.60), next to the topmost points.
